Fortnite x Superman Season 3 Trailer TL;DR


Epic Games just dropped a cinematic trailer announcing Superman as the lead hero for Fortnite Season 3, kicking off July 11.

articles.author: Movie News
articles.description:
Sean and Amanda kick off the episode by hyping the blockbuster opening of F1 and dissecting the slick new trailer for Phil Lord and Chris Miller’s Project Hail Mary with Ryan Gosling.  
They’re then joined by a star-studded Ringer crew—Rob Mahoney, Van Lathan, Chris Ryan, Mallory Rubin, Joanna Robinson, Charles Holmes, Adam Nayman and Grace Fennessey—to unveil their top 10 movies of the year so far, mixing big hits, hidden gems and one deliberately divisive pick that’s sure to stir up some friendly Ringer beef.
articles.title: Ringer Movies: The 10 Best Movies of the Year ... So Far | The Big Picture

articles.author: Movie News
articles.description:
The Ringer’s Bill Simmons and Sean Fennessey kick off their latest episode by craving that plaster-of-Paris bagel-and-cream-cheese paperweight, then dive into Martin Scorsese’s 1985 neo-noir comedy After Hours—exploring why it’s an underrated classic, hashing out their most rewatchable scene, and throwing down some fun category challenges.
Produced by Jack Sanders and Ronak Nair, this episode is brought to you by Holiday Inn and State Farm. Check out the timestamps (0:00 Cold Open; 2:41 Why After Hours is a classic; 42:11 Best Rewatchable Scene; 49:05 The Categories), subscribe on Ringer-Verse or Bill Simmons’ YouTube, and follow The Ringer on social media.
articles.title: Ringer Movies: ‘After Hours' with Bill Simmons and Sean Fennessey | The Rewatchables

articles.author: Movie News
articles.description:
TL;DR


Sean Fennessey and Amanda Dobbins kick things off by reacting to Christopher Nolan’s new trailer for The Odyssey before diving into Gareth Edwards’s Jurassic World Rebirth. With Chris Ryan in tow, they unpack their complicated—and sometimes contentious—feelings on the dino-action flick starring Scarlett Johansson and Mahershala Ali.  
Later, Sean sits down with Eva Victor to talk about her debut feature, Sorry, Baby. They cover everything from pitching to investors and the emotional roller coaster of press tours to her hopes for what comes next in her career.
articles.title: Ringer Movies: ‘Jurassic World Rebirth' Does Not Find a Way. Plus: ‘The Odyssey' Is Coming! | The Big Picture

articles.author: Movie News
articles.description:
Sean and Amanda pick up their yearlong quest to rank the top 25 films of the 21st century and dive into Christopher Nolan’s Oppenheimer. They debate why this Cillian Murphy–led biopic snagged the official Nolan spot on their list, whether it might stand as the director’s crowning achievement, and what kind of legacy it’ll leave behind.
Along the way they riff on Oppenheimer’s iconic status, trade hot takes about Nolan’s career arc, and speculate how future cinephiles will view this atomic-era masterpiece.
articles.title: Ringer Movies: The 25 Best Movies of the Century: No. 16 - ‘Oppenheimer' | The Big Picture

articles.author: Movie News
articles.description:
Sean and Amanda team up with Chris Ryan for Part 2 of their 2025 Movie Auction, kicking things off with a heartfelt tribute to Michael Madsen, who passed away at 67. After running through last season’s picks and clarifying the auction rules and scoring system, they dive right into this year’s draft.
On the block are some true tent-pole thrillers—think Superman and Avatar: Fire and Ash—alongside a handful of under-the-radar indies like The Ballad of a Small Player and It Was Just an Accident, all up for bidding in what promises to be another wild ride.
articles.title: Ringer Movies: The 2025 Movie Auction Returns! | The Big Picture

SwiftUI Design System: A Complete Guide to Building Consistent UI Components (2025)


Ever opened a SwiftUI project and found yourself staring at Color.blue in one view, Color(hex: "#007AFF") in another, and some random Color.accentColor sprinkled throughout? 
Yeah, I've been there too. We've all been there.
Building apps without a proper design system feels productive at first – you're moving fast, shipping features, getting stuff done. But then you need to update that shade of blue across your entire app, and suddenly you're playing hide-and-seek with hardcoded values scattered across 47 different files.
In this comprehensive guide, I'll show you how to build a complete design system from scratch:
🎨 Design Tokens Foundation
Semantic color naming that actually makes sense
Typography syst…
articles.title: SwiftUI Design System: A Complete Guide to Building Consistent UI Components (2025)

The Rewatchables Tackles Jaws 2


Bill Simmons, Chris Ryan, and Sean Fennessey dive into the 1978 sequel Jaws 2—exploring how it kicked off Hollywood’s obsession with follow-ups, debating its most rewatchable scene, and awarding their signature categories along the way.
